attributes.board_name: Oklahoma State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category I as defined by the American Medical Association / Oklahoma State Medical Association / American Academy of Family Physicians or another certifying organization recognized by the Board
rules.alternatives: Accepted as verification at audit: current AMA Physician Recognition Award; ABMS specialty board certification or recertification obtained during the 3-year period; residency or fellowship in the preceding 3 years (50 hours per completed training year).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Newly licensed physicians begin reporting three years from the date licensure was granted.
rules.audit_note: Licensee certifies every three years; each year the Board randomly or for cause audits licensees, who must submit verification.

topics.who: Each year before renewal: 1 hour pain management or 1 hour opioid use or addiction; not required if the licensee holds no valid federal DEA registration (59 O.S. § 495a.1)

rules.notes: Board guidelines also cite 63 O.S. § 3162: once every two calendar years, providers associated with an inpatient health care entity must view a State online presentation (counts toward CME); its subject is not stated on the Board page.

rules.accepted_credit_types: AOA Category 1; DOs obtaining or maintaining ABMS board certification may use AMA PRA Category 1 credit
rules.new_licensee_rule: Residents/fellows at any time during the CME cycle are exempt; CME applies from the first July 1 after graduation from residency or fellowship.
rules.audit_note: CE Broker completion check at renewal: the renewal cannot proceed unless CME requirements are met; exceptions must be entered in CE Broker each cycle.

topics.who: DOs with OBNDD/DEA registration: pain management, opioid use or addiction; course pre-approved by the Board, reported by the provider

rules.notes: Licensed by the separate Oklahoma State Board of Osteopathic Examiners (oklahoma.gov/osboe). CME cycle July 1 - June 30; licenses expire June 30 each year. Medical marijuana recommenders: 2 hours/year (no topic code).
